## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Pricing and paywall.**
      4 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Oct 5, 2026 - Oct 8, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Stephen G_, Oct 7, 2026, 1/5: "Works reasonably well for plotting out meals and how they will effect your macros. But the app frequently crashes and you have to check nutritional info on entries carefully, as there are often multiple entries with most incorrect. Then lately, it has me locked out of being able to adjust my macros and caloric intake. Then it frequently bugs you about paying for premium, but the issues are annoying enough without paying for it."
            2. _Kristine Schlingman_, Oct 6, 2026, 1/5: "This app used to be so helpful and the owners got greedy and are taking away all the features that make the free app usable and making them paid. I will be finding a free more useful app to use."
            3. _David R_, Oct 8, 2026, 2/5: "slow and expensive for what I use it for"

         **Review examples:**
